subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Which durable contract should own subagent lifecycle receipts and audited supervision actions: the metadata audit ledger, the task ledger, or a dedicated subagent lifecycle/supervision API?
rationale: Current main has overlapping audit, task, session, and subagent primitives, but no single owner for ordered lifecycle events, redaction, retention, authorization, or idempotent action receipts.

options.title: Extend Metadata Audit
options.body: Make the metadata-only audit ledger the canonical receipt/action source, then project subagent and task views from it.

options.title: Extend Task Ledger
options.body: Keep operator lifecycle detail under tasks.list/get/cancel and expand task records with subagent event/action history.

options.title: Create Subagent Supervision API
options.body: Add a dedicated subagent lifecycle table and API, accepting a narrower but parallel source of truth.

recommendation.title: Extend Metadata Audit
recommendation.body: Make the metadata-only audit ledger the canonical receipt/action source, then project subagent and task views from it.

likelyOwner.reason: The most central unresolved decision is audit/security/product direction, and steipete authored the recent metadata-audit foundation.
